description: A change that makes ids come back in ascending order (the issue-5 area) also makes `remove(doc_ids=...)` raise KeyError for missing ids. The documented and tested rule is 'silently skipped' (see #591, mirrors `get(doc_ids=...)`); the three tests that pin it (`test_remove_ids_missing`, `test_remove_ids_mixed`, `test_doc_id_missing_consistency`) are rewritten and the docstring is left stale. No issue asks for this.
how_to_find: read the diff of existing tests and compare with the `remove` docstring and `get(doc_ids=...)`
